svg.title: THE RIG wordmark v0.3
svg.desc: THE RIG wordmark v0.3 lock 2026-05-12. THE in Inter Medium 14px Steel #64748b · letter-spacing 9 · breathing. RIG in Inter Black 900 · 58px Navy #0f172a · letter-spacing -2.5 · anchored. Hierarchy enacts the rigid+flow duality: THE breathes (light · letter-spaced · Steel) · RIG holds (heavy · tight kerning · Navy).
